motion.name: food-arrival
motion.purpose: Fast rise, then a smooth overshoot and settling dip; 30px/7px main, 18px/4px sides.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Hero preview action; no production destination.
components.css: .ds-button { font: 13px "DM Sans", sans-serif; min-height: 52px; padding: 0 24px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 20px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 3px; cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s, transform .2s; } .ds-button:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #d78700; outline-offset: 6px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } } .ds-button { background: var(--red, #800b0c); color: #fff9f0; } .ds-button:hover { background: #a41418; }

components.name: Food Placeholder
components.description: Empty blue main strip; intentionally provisional.
components.css: .ds-food { display:flex; align-items:center; justify-content:space-between; background:var(--blue, #0738d5); color:white; padding:22px 26px; font:11px "DM Sans",sans-serif; letter-spacing:.17em; transform:rotate(-8.5deg); }

components.name: Text Holder
components.css: .ds-holder { background:#e6e2dd; min-height:210px; display:flex; flex-direction:column; justify-content:center; align-items:center; gap:24px; padding:28px; } .ds-holder h1 { margin:0; font:italic 400 clamp(54px,7vw,96px)/1.1 "Lobster Two",cursive; letter-spacing:-.03em; color:#211b17; } .ds-holder span { font:11px "DM Sans",sans-serif; color:#696159; letter-spacing:.19em; }

components.name: Replay Control
components.html: <button class="ds-replay"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.5" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10a8 8 0 1 1 1 7M4 4v6h6"/></svg>Putar ulang intro</button>
components.css: .ds-replay { display:flex; align-items:center; gap:9px; border:0; padding:12px 0 12px 12px; background:transparent; color:var(--red, #800b0c); font:12px "DM Sans",sans-serif; cursor:pointer; } .ds-replay svg { width:18px; height:18px; transition:transform .4s cubic-bezier(.16,1,.3,1); } .ds-replay:hover svg { transform:rotate(-40deg); } .ds-replay:focus-visible { outline:3px solid #d78700; outline-offset:6px; } @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce) { .ds-replay svg { transition:none; } }

narrative.overview: This document records the owner-approved intro and hero prototype, not a complete restaurant website. The visual direction pairs yellow script on dark red with a spacious cream hero. Gray copy and blue image placeholders intentionally remain visible.
keyCharacteristics: Connected Pacifico pen strokes animated by Vivus over 2.8 seconds: Resep before Nurolanda, followed by glow and curtain reveal.
Centered copy and two compact calls to action.
Three tilted, empty blue food strips, with delayed side entrances.
dos: Do preserve local fonts, keyboard controls and reduced-motion behavior.
Do retain approved empty placeholders until replacement content is supplied.
donts: Don't present preview buttons as completed ordering or menu flows.
Don't treat this hero composition as a requirement for future screens.
